description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares several pure virtual methods for handling various events related to runtime, window, ripple, and state change, all of which involve JSON-formatted data.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class defining event handler callbacks for different event types, meant to be implemented by classes that handle events involving JSON data

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events with provided JSON data

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events with provided JSON data

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events with a name identifier and JSON data

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events with provided JSON data
